messages:
lina (AE): Heads up — ACME is in the middle of a POC and can't get their Splunk logs to match Console traces. They also flagged a security questionnaire item about log retention/export controls. Demo demo-blocker tomorrow AM. Can @tom / @rachel triage?

acme-poc: When we enable the log drain to Splunk HEC we only see gateway logs, but Console shows trace IDs and model events we need for debugging. The Splunk events don't have `trace_id` or the original `X-Request-Id`. Example HEC event we received: `{"time":1640995200,"host":"gateway-1","event":{"path":"/v1/generate","status":200}}` — no trace.

tom (Sales SE): Are you using hosted Redwood or private? Also, what header are you emitting for correlation?

acme-poc: hosted. Our SDK recent change puts `X-Request-Id` on requests. We didn't switch to W3C `traceparent`. We can modify client but prefer platform mapping.

rachel (eng-infra): OK two paths: 1) temporary tenant-level header mapping on ingress that maps `X-Request-Id -> traceparent` (or copies to `x-trace-id`) and also ensures logs/HEC payload include `x-original-request-id`; 2) configure Splunk HEC transform to pick headers from incoming drain (if drain forwards headers). Which drain method did you configure? HTTP POST to HEC?

acme-poc: yes HEC POST. We used the standard URL and token from your docs. We can add transforms, but easier if Redwood includes the header in the event body.

sam (devex): we can inject metadata into the drain payload. We already support `include_headers: true` on drain configs, but it's off by default for hosted tenants. @rachel would mapping + include_headers be an easy toggle for acct-5102?

rachel (eng-infra): yes. Need tenant id (acct-5102) and an auth owner. We should schedule a 15m window to update drain config so we can restart the connector without losing events. Maintenance window tonight OK?

acme-poc: confirmed acct-5102 and owner is me. Window fine after 21:00 PT. Also asked: will this affect GDPR/PII retention flags? Our security team wants a record.

jorge (security): Adding notes — if we enable header capture in drain payloads, we must ensure sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie) are scrubbed and that retention policies carry through to Splunk exports. We'll need a signed SOC/terms addendum for log retention >90 days. I can draft a minimal addendum.

lina (AE): ACME also asked about pricing for additional retention / audit logs — can sales give a quick estimate?

tom (Sales SE): Pricing: extra log retention & exported retention via Splunk add-on is typically $X/mo per GB for hosted. I'll DM acct owner with ballpark and flag for finance.

deploy-bot: deploy:drain-connector acct-5102 scheduled at 2026-03-21T21:05:00Z by rachel, id=drain-8392

rachel (eng-infra): implemented tenant config: `include_headers: true`, header mapping rule: `X-Request-Id -> x-trace-id` (copied to `x-original-request-id` as well). Connector restarted at 2026-03-21T21:06:10Z.

acme-poc: receiving events now. Here's a sample HEC payload after change: `{"time":1640995560,"host":"gateway-2","event":{"path":"/v1/generate","status":200,"x-trace-id":"00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01","x-original-request-id":"c3f8a9"}}` — trace shows up!

sam (devex): great. Two follow-ups: 1) recommend ACME update SDK to 0.9.4 to emit W3C `traceparent` natively, 2) @jorge will we need the addendum signed before enabling retention >90d?

jorge (security): yes for >90d or cross-region export we need addendum. For the short term (their demo) approving header capture is fine; I'll ship the addendum template to lina and acct owner for review. Also add a note that exported payloads will respect `redact_headers: [Authorization]`.

acme-poc: quick Q: can Console show the original X-Request-Id as a column for our ops team so they don't have to parse Splunk?

rachel (eng-infra): yes, we added `x-original-request-id` to our log schema so Console will show it as `original_request_id` in metadata. You can add it via Live Tail columns: Observability -> Live Tail -> Columns -> original_request_id.

lina (AE): any blocker on the security questionnaire item now?

jorge (security): I'll complete the retention section and sign off once legal approves the addendum. ETA eod.

acme-poc: confirmed demo results: Splunk + Console correlate now, trace ids present, and retention question acknowledged. Thanks team.

tom (Sales SE): I'll follow up with pricing DM and contract next steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

lina (AE): marking resolved for now — will reopen if legal holds up addendum.

deploy-bot: ticket: 4382 closed (drain-8392)
